title: Web App Promo
description: A cinematic app launch: masked editorial type, an uncluttered 3D screen reveal and a confident closing invitation.
creativeDirection: Audience: people evaluating a web app. Direction: a cinematic editorial product demo led by expressive type and the actual interface. Keep a continuous dark ink canvas, white condensed headlines, restrained lavender and a pink brand signature. Reveal the promise through a baseline mask, let a brief camera pull settle the opening, then move into a shallow perspective screen reveal that resolves to a readable flat view. A subtle forward drift adds depth without covering the recorded interaction. Finish with a large centered invitation and a stable final hold. Keep feature copy outside the capture. No decorative slabs, scene counters, fake window controls, oversized play symbols or bouncing geometry. Review the entrances, readable screen hold, widest allowed copy and final invitation. Preserve the existing native flat fallback on mobile; creative direction itself does not execute animation. Motion: fly through the promise into the interface, a twin glint crosses the screen as it lands flat, push up to the invitation, a round-capped pink rule settles under the call to action.

description: A full-bleed three-chapter reel with alternating caption anchors, snappy opposing entrances and clean rhythmic cuts.
creativeDirection: Audience: people watching a vertical three-chapter story. Direction: full-bleed footage throughout, with alternating caption anchors and clean rhythmic cuts. Use readable, high-contrast captions as punctuation rather than turning each chapter into a title card. Oppose entrance directions to distinguish chapters; let the footage remain dominant after the short reveal. Alternate the chapter indicator side and give each caption one small overshoot, then hold the footage without decorative overlays. Motion: chapters swipe in like stories; a brief warm leak washes in from the side each new chapter enters, and a fine grain binds the three clips.

creativeDirection: Audience: estate agents who post listings as short videos. Direction: the photos carry the mood, the cards carry the facts, one idea per scene. Scene one says where and how much: the address card rises bottom left once the push-in has started, the price tag slides in from the right half a second later. Scene two says what you get: a stat row (rooms, area, floor) and feature chips settle on the right while the camera drifts. Scene three says what to do: the open-visit badge drops in, then the agent's card with a round portrait. Push and zoom-through transitions keep the reel moving; nothing waits more than a beat. Copy comes from the fields, so the same template lists any property. Review: text crisp at 720p, round corners, nothing cut at a card's edge, the price never covers the lamp, and every layer is hidden until its entrance.
